messages.subject: Multiple testing in Lavaan-sem
parts:
Hello to all,
Is anyone knows how to address or correct multiple testing in SEM?
Thank you, Aline

messages.author: 54c05e928c45ac6c
messages.subject: Re: Multiple testing in Lavaan-sem
parts:
You can use any standard approach, such as dividing test statistics or p-value based on number of comparisons. Bonferroni or whatever.

However, understand that the correction is with respect to the model. Just because an SEM has a hundred parameters in a single model with factors doesn't mean that your family wise error rate changes.
